sources.name: USGS North American Bat Monitoring Program acoustic data
sources.notes: Verify exact release license, individual download links, annotation provenance and machine-vs-manual labels.

sources.name: Western Soundscape Archive
sources.notes: Do not copy or redistribute recordings without recordist or archive authorization.

sources.name: Macaulay Library
sources.notes: Obtain media access and verify recording-specific training and redistribution terms.

sources.name: Xeno-canto land mammals
sources.notes: Check noncommercial restrictions and individual file licenses before use.

sources.name: BirdVox
sources.notes: Select a specific release; flight-call event labels are not necessarily species labels.

sources.name: Eastern North American Forest Soundscapes
sources.notes: Verify exact release, licenses, event labels and archive size.

sources.name: Cry Wolf Project
sources.notes: Research material does not imply public bulk download rights.

sources.name: Chronister et al. Eastern North American bird annotations (Powdermill)
sources.notes: Prefer MP3 archive plus annotations over duplicate WAV archive; 385 min, 48 species, strong labels; exact license review required.

sources.name: Annotated Western United States soundscapes (Sierra Nevada)
sources.notes: 33h, 56 bird species, strong labels. Optional subset; do not crowd out mammals.

sources.name: University of Michigan Animal Diversity Web frog calls
sources.notes: Download buttons for North American species; audio reuse/training permissions are not established.

sources.name: Xeno-canto Anura recordings
sources.notes: Filter by North American recording location, verify per-recording media rights; GBIF may be metadata only.

sources.name: Amphibian Monitoring Pilot Project
sources.notes: 175.58h collected, 11.92h manually scanned; files and reuse terms need confirmation.

sources.name: Earth Species alp-data dataset discovery/loader
sources.notes: Framework, not a single dataset; per-source licenses and regional filtration required.

sources.name: BEANS benchmark
sources.notes: Entire benchmark requires ~300 GB to unpack: do not download wholesale under a 30 GB cap.

sources.name: NABat Acoustic ML v2
sources.notes: Classifier/code and evaluation workflow; not a substitute for verifying the 2026 acoustic audio records.

sources.name: NPS Natural Sounds gallery
sources.notes: NPS says gallery files are public domain and downloadable; clip pages give context. Verify individual asset rights/credits and source labels before storing.

sources.name: Yellowstone National Park sound library
sources.notes: Yellowstone states its park-recorded audio is public domain. Preserve per-recording credits and recording context; some grizzly clips were made during a temporary capture, and several bear audio pages include third-party collaborations.

sources.name: USFS Pacific Northwest annotated soundscapes (Weldy et al. 2024)
sources.notes: Fully annotated archive 1.8 GB ZIP, 141 five-minute files; annotation dictionary lists 2 mammal species including domestic dog and Douglas squirrel. American pika and bullfrog have 0 annotations; do not imply confirmed training examples. 2-second sound-tag windows, not precise vocalization onsets. Verify license field.

storage_cap_note: Hard maximum 30 GB final audio corpus; include metadata, staging overhead, extracted size, and checksum audit when allocating; do not download the full 27.7 GB bird dataset by default.
